Accessibility

Accessibility statement

How this website is built to be usable by everyone, and how to reach us if any part of it is not.

BlueFox Landscape & Services wants everyone to be able to use this website, including people who use assistive technology.

How this website is built

The site is built to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA:

  • Every page can be used with a keyboard alone, starting with a "Skip to content" link, and the focused element always shows a visible outline.
  • Text and controls are checked for colour contrast against the background they actually sit on.
  • Menus, accordions, the before-and-after sliders and the quote forms are built from native controls, so screen readers announce them correctly.
  • Photographs carry text descriptions; decorative graphics are hidden from screen readers.
  • Animation is reduced or switched off when your device asks for reduced motion.
  • Tap targets on phones are at least 44 pixels, and text reflows at every screen width without sideways scrolling.

Here For You

If you are experiencing difficulty with any content on www.bluefoxlandscapeandservices.com or require assistance with any part of our site, please contact us during normal business hours as detailed below and we will be happy to assist.

Contact Us

If you wish to report an accessibility issue, have any questions or need assistance, please contact www.bluefoxlandscapeandservices.com Customer Support as follows:

Email: bluefoxlandscapeandservices@gmail.com
